summary: A single choice from a group, in three sizes, three shapes and three shadows, with an optional description and icon per option.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices. `value` and `label` are required; `description` and `icon` are optional per option. The shape is fixed rather than generic because you own the file: data that does not fit is an edit to the option body, not an API.

props.name: label
props.description: A caption above the group, correctly wired to it via `aria-labelledby`. Without one the group has no accessible name at all.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The option selected when you are not controlling the group. Pair `value` with `onValueChange` instead if you are.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value. Required for a controlled group.

props.name: size
props.description: The circle, the dot and the label together.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on an unselected circle. A selected one is already a solid fill, so it does not carry the shadow - stacking one on top muddies the colour.

props.name: iconSide
props.description: Which side each option's `icon` sits on, when it has one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims every option.

props.name: animate
props.description: The dot's transition when selection changes. Turn it off for a static group, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the group's classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
